name: passport-balancer
description: Self-hosted stagenet balancing service for Midnight Passport: holds NIGHT, registers it for DUST, and balances transaction fees for Passport wallets on stagenet — the stagenet counterpart of the fee sponsorship the demo already relies on.
//compact-runtime: Pinned to 0.19.0-rc.0, not 0.19.0, on purpose (2026/09/11). The two packages are
byte-identical apart from the version string, and 0.19.0-rc.0 is exactly what
compact-js 2.5.5-rc.8 and midnight-js-protocol 5.0.0-beta.7 depend on, so every
npm resolves ONE copy of the runtime with no override. The override this replaced
was read differently by npm 10 (the builders' npm) and npm 11: npm 10 kept a second,
nested runtime under compact-js or the protocol package, and two copies of the runtime
are two ChargedState classes. Contract code compiled by compactc 0.34.0 asserts
runtime 0.19.0 and ignores the pre-release tag, so rc.0 satisfies it. The
ledger-8 funder keeps its own 0.16.0 untouched.
